rationale: I compared v2 (bytes f95fff65...) key by key, after sorting, with the blind version (e34a3941...). As the producer stated, exactly three fields changed. (1) The rationale no longer says no command has an own-terms end. It correctly says that sec. 9's authority to pay Commission expenditures from the President's Emergency Fund was limited to 'During the fiscal year 1961' and 'during the fiscal year 1962'. That authority lapsed on its own terms after FY1962 (June 30, 1962), before the 1967 revocation. The President-fixed compensation sentence and secs. 1-8 carry no time limit. The lapse is partial, which I confirmed against the held sec. 9 text (CLAUSES sec9, sec9-1960, sec9-c). (2) observations_reviewed now equals the history packet's observation_ids exactly: [API:cc045a3cc44ba1b1043839a9, S1989:fb9946435563a3f38b93f9d9]. The appended sentence correctly identifies API:a1f0872494c3c3ca7c4d6219 as the supporting note of EO 11374 ('Revokes: EO 10946, May 26, 1961') and treats it as a lead only. (3) The retained gap now names the sec. 9 lapse and residual compensation/fund questions. All other fields are unchanged: recommendation 'no', empty proposed_intervals, null current predicate, and matching evidence (372fcbd0...) and history (3d99ddb6...) fingerprints. My blind verification still stands. The held text hashes match: EO_10946.txt 380a6151... and EO_11374.txt 124f998e.... The ACT span (chars 2255-2318) is the exact sec. 6 text 'Executive Order No. 10946 of May 26, 1961, is hereby revoked.', with whole scope and no savings. Identity is confirmed: 26 FR 4629, May 26, 1961. EO 11374 (32 FR 14199, signed Oct. 11, 1967) abolishes the Commission and transfers its functions, records, property and pending disputes to FMCS (secs. 1-5), then revokes EO 10946 without qualification. The cruden search found no other citing instrument and no revival. The history has no flags. Lifecycle gaps remain. EO 11374 states no effective date, and signing/publication are not asserted as the end. Residual matters (pending disputes, records, any fixed compensation) are unresolved. No complete later-source search through 2026-10-14 has been done. Pages were not image-checked. This is a nonauthoritative provisional NO; no owner adoption or human certification follows.
